available.quote: The Board may, by endorsement, without written examination, license as a registered nurse an applicant who, on or after July 1, 1983, is duly licensed as a registered nurse or is entitled to perform similar services under a different title under the laws of another state or territory

requirements.value: Applicant must meet qualifications specified by this chapter for registered nurses in Delaware; if not actively employed in professional nursing in past 5 years, must complete a refresher program within 2 years prior to endorsement.
requirements.quote: if, in the opinion of the Board, the applicant meets the qualifications specified by this chapter for registered nurses in this State... In the event the applicant has not been actively employed in professional nursing in the past 5 years, the applicant will be required to give evidence of satisfactory completion of a professional nursing refresher program with an approved agency within 2 years prior to endorsement before licensure by endorsement will be granted.

definition_quote.value: The practice of professional nursing as a registered nurse means the performance of professional nursing services by a person who holds a valid license pursuant to the terms of this chapter, and who bears primary responsibility and accountability for nursing practices based on specialized knowledge, judgment, and skill derived from the principles of biological, physical, and behavioral sciences.
definition_quote.quote: "The practice of professional nursing" as a registered nurse means the performance of professional nursing services by a person who holds a valid license pursuant to the terms of this chapter, and who bears primary responsibility and accountability for nursing practices based on specialized knowledge, judgment, and skill derived from the principles of biological, physical, and behavioral sciences.

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: A multistate license to practice registered or licensed practical/vocational nursing issued by a home state to a resident in that state will be recognized by each party state as authorizing a nurse to practice as a registered nurse (RN) or as a licensed practical/vocational nurse (LPN/VN), under a multistate licensure privilege, in each party state.

multistate_license_option_available.quote: Individuals not residing in a party state shall continue to be able to apply for a party state's single-state license as provided under the laws of each party state.

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: "Alternative program" means a nondisciplinary monitoring program approved by a licensing board.

rn_death_pronouncement_authorized.quote: A registered nurse shall have the authority, as part of the practice of professional nursing, to make a pronouncement of death; provided, however, that this provision shall only apply to attending nurses caring for terminally ill patients or patients who have "do not resuscitate" orders

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Health-care providers, including nurses licensed by the Delaware Board of Nursing, are authorized to deliver health-care services by telehealth and telemedicine. A provider-patient relationship must be established, and prescriptions may not be issued solely in response to an internet questionnaire, internet consult, or telephone consult without a proper provider-patient relationship.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: In the absence of a proper health-care provider-patient relationship, health-care providers are prohibited from issuing prescriptions solely in response to an internet questionnaire, an internet consult, or a telephone consult.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.citation: § 6003. Scope of practice; provider-patient relationship required.
